description: Validates interaction-flow diagrams exist, are consolidated at the project level, and every edge is verified against actual mockup navigation

checks.remediation: Run screen-generateflow against the project's screen-inventory.json and all SCR-*/mockup.html files

checks.description: At least one Mermaid flowchart diagram must be present
checks.remediation: Use flowchart LR per screen-generateflow's conventions, not a sequence diagram (reserved for diagram-generatecollaboration's system-interaction use case)

checks.description: A Verification Log confirming edges trace to real mockup links must be present — this is the non-skippable manual verification step required by TR-07.1
checks.remediation: Per TR-07.1, manually verify every diagram edge against an actual <a href> in a mockup.html file and log it — do not publish unverified edges

checks.description: Interaction flows should use flowchart, not sequenceDiagram, syntax — screen navigation is not a time-ordered message exchange between system components
checks.remediation: Reserve sequenceDiagram for diagram-generatecollaboration's actor/boundary/control/entity message modeling; use flowchart LR for screen-to-screen navigation

checks.description: Flow IDs should follow the IF-[###] convention, independently sequenced (not paired to a Screen ID)
checks.remediation: Use the IF-[###] format from ui-prototyping-conventions.md
